en: Colorized early-20th‑century postcard showing a grand historic villa labeled "Villa Kertsch" in Brașov, Romania. The multi‑storey building has a corner tower, bay windows and an iron fence with a garden in front. Pedestrians and a horse‑drawn carriage are visible on the street. Small shop signs include one for a dentist and another reading HOTEL. The reverse is a divided back printed in Romanian, with the publisher credit and a 1925 date.
